operations.name: mediaListCollection

operations.auth: Not required — public data. Pass a token for viewer-scoped fields.

request.name: userId

request.description: a number representing the start date of the media. AniList's `FuzzyDateInt` form: a `YYYYMMDD` integer (for example `19980401`); build it with `aniLink.anilist.fuzzyDateInt`.

request.name: perChunk

request.name: completedAt_greater

operations.purpose: AniListCustom.custom sends a caller-authored GraphQL query or mutation document to AniList.
